title: Concept: Dependency declared with a hyphen range
description: package.json declares a hyphen range that spans several minor or major releases, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The range accepts every release between the two ends, including ones published after review, so an upgrade happens silently on the next install.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The range accepts every release between the two ends, including ones published after review, so an upgrade happens silently on the next install.
